# Set-ZbxGraph

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a graph.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxGraph [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixGraph>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Uuid <string>] [-YMinItemId <ulong>] [-YMaxItemId <ulong>] [-Width <int>] [-Height <int>] [-YAxisMin <double>] [-YAxisMax <double>] [-ShowWorkPeriod <bool>] [-ShowTriggers <bool>] [-GraphType <ZabbixGraphType>] [-ShowLegend <bool>] [-Show3d <bool>] [-PercentLeft <double>] [-PercentRight <double>] [-YMinType <ZabbixGraphYAxisType>] [-YMaxType <ZabbixGraphYAxisType>] [-GraphItem <ZabbixGraphUpdateGraphItemRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A graph plots the values of one or more items over time, as lines, stacked areas, a pie or an exploded pie. The Set-ZbxGraph cmdlet changes the graphs given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with graph.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every graph the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed graphs back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a graph

```powershell
Set-ZbxGraph -InputObject 'CPU load' -Height 300
```

Makes the graph CPU load 300 pixels high.

### Example 2: Change a graph and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxGraph -InputObject 'CPU load' -Height 300 -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the graph CPU load back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixGraph>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Uuid (ByPropertyName), -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ulong`: Bound to -YMinItemId (ByPropertyName), -YMaxItemId (ByPropertyName).
- `int`: Bound to -Width (ByPropertyName), -Height (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `double`: Bound to -YAxisMin (ByPropertyName), -YAxisMax (ByPropertyName), -PercentLeft (ByPropertyName), -PercentRight (ByPropertyName).
- `bool`: Bound to -ShowWorkPeriod (ByPropertyName), -ShowTriggers (ByPropertyName), -ShowLegend (ByPropertyName), -Show3d (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixGraphType`: Bound to -GraphType (ByPropertyName). The graph type values: GRAPH_TYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixGraphYAxisType`: Bound to -YMinType (ByPropertyName), -YMaxType (ByPropertyName). How a graph sets the minimum or maximum of its Y axis.
- `ZabbixGraphUpdateGraphItemRequest[]`: Bound to -GraphItem (ByPropertyName). gitems of a ZabbixGraphUpdateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixGraph`: The graph read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.
